summary: Iteration 29 focused on card-redesign PDF endpoints, homepage on-page verification removal + routing consolidation to /verify, and successful verification of the reactivated real certificate AGR-RBY-000015-26. All 8 backend tests pass (sample-card PDF 1-page, demo-preview PDF ≥4 pages, real cert cover PNG, real cert PDF ≥4 pages, admin cert card PDF, QR bogus-token no-crash, cover 404 for bogus number, counter still 15). Frontend: after a supervisor restart which cleared a stale-bundle state (webpack was serving an outdated bundle from before recent edits), homepage no longer has a verification form (all verify-* testids count=0), /?qr=TOKEN redirects to /verify?t=TOKEN, /verify page uses registration-number-only (no security-code input, no password field), AGR-RBY-000015-26 resolves to a cover image + view-details button + PDF iframe modal, invalid cert shows verify-search-error, /verify?t=BOGUS loads without crash, header VERIFY nav + Legality page (/legalitas) legality-cta-verify + homepage hero CTA all route to /verify. Footer footer-admin-signin present; no nav-login in header. No mutations performed; counter=15 confirmed.
action_items: None blocking. Note: initial page load served a STALE frontend bundle (pre-cleanup HomePage with 'AUTHENTICITY VERIFICATION' form still visible) until supervisor restart recompiled webpack. The frontend.err.log retained old TS errors from a prior VisualsPage.tsx state that had already been fixed; after `supervisorctl restart frontend` it compiled cleanly ('No issues found'). Main agent may want to verify the dev-server is picking up latest edits without manual restart in future iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: Route path for Legality is `/legalitas` (Indonesian) while public UI default locale is English and the header label is 'LEGALITY'. Not a bug (LEGALITY link points at /legalitas) but a minor inconsistency; consider aliasing /legality → /legalitas for shareability.

VerifyPage uses testids `verify-search-input`/`verify-search-submit`, but constants/testIds.ts also defines unused `verify-cert-input`/`verify-submit`. Dead constants should be removed to prevent test drift (review request itself referenced the wrong testids).

Verify PDF iframe src is a blob: URL rather than a direct /api/verify/pdf/{n} URL; asserting the underlying endpoint via src is not possible. Consider setting a stable data attribute (e.g., data-src or data-cert-number) so tests can assert intent.

rca of the issue: Initial homepage screenshot showed the 'AUTHENTICITY VERIFICATION → Verify Certificate' block still rendering even though HomePage.tsx source has no such block. Root cause: webpack dev server was serving a stale compiled bundle from before recent edits (frontend.err.log retained old TS1109/TS1128 errors on VisualsPage.tsx that had since been fixed). After `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`, webpack recompiled cleanly and served the current code — homepage form disappeared, /?qr= redirect began working, and Legality CTA to /verify rendered. Mitigation: main agent should ensure dev server picks up latest source; if HMR gets stuck after multi-file rewrites, a supervisor restart resolves it.
